instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina focuses on high-margin niche content where operational scaling is key to profitability, requiring constant optimization of production pipelines and licensing agreements across global markets. They manage complex IP rights for international streaming deals while navigating the rapidly evolving technical requirements of cloud production infrastructure.
answers.pastInitiatives: Historically, Lumina has optimized its post-production workflow by implementing proprietary automation scripts for asset management, which reduced turnaround time by 15%. They also piloted a localized content delivery network (CDN) strategy to mitigate bandwidth costs during peak streaming seasons.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions.
answers.additionalContext: Given the high regulatory environment in media distribution and the micro company size, Lumina must balance creative freedom with stringent compliance requirements for content localization and data privacy. They are currently exploring decentralized production models as a way to bypass traditional studio overheads while maintaining quality control.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Hyper-Localized Content Assembly Pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Given the high pressure on efficiency and bold risk appetite, implementing radical automation in content assembly could drastically reduce production time and variable costs associated with localization. This moves beyond incremental improvements by fundamentally changing how content is packaged and delivered.

first_actions: Pilot an AI script coverage tool to generate localized metadata for three existing projects.
Establish a dedicated, cross-functional 'Efficiency Task Force' within the existing team.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Software licensing for specialized automation tools ($15k)
Consulting fee for workflow redesign expertise ($20k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of average project turnaround time by 30% within 6 months.
milestones: Q1: Successful pilot completion and ROI analysis.
Q2: Full integration roadmap for the assembly pipeline.

opportunities.title: Automated Rights Clearance and Compliance Micro-SaaS
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing formal process, creating a micro-SaaS tool to automate manual rights clearance checks would significantly reduce legal risk and administrative time. This is an incremental efficiency gain that minimizes operational friction.

first_actions: Identify top 5 high-risk content categories for automated tracking.
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) using existing legal templates.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual rights review time by 50%.
milestones: Month 2: MVP launch and internal testing.
Month 4: Full integration into the formal process.

next_steps.action: Conduct deep-dive feasibility study on AI content assembly tools and their integration cost/benefit.
Formalize the 'Efficiency Task Force' mandate, allocating a dedicated subset of developer time to high-impact process improvements.

key_weaknesses: Extreme dependency on owner decision-making which can lead to resource misalignment and scope creep.
Severe talent bottleneck: reliance on generalist developers who lack specialized R&D/innovation skills for new technologies.
Formal innovation process is likely too slow and bureaucratic given the micro company size, leading to missed opportunities or 'time' barriers.
Highly constrained capital budget (24% of revenue) severely limits investment in necessary technical tooling and talent acquisition.
